caption.text:
Words from the book ‘You Were Always Growing’ by Charlotte Freeman ❤️
If you have lost someone you love, it’s hard to believe
you will be okay again and it’s even harder to imagine
your life without them. Honestly, it’s hard to imagine
anything at all. You may have no interest in living a life without them in it, the truth is, though, life keeps going and so must you. You have to keep living for the ones who loved you. You have to keep loving for the ones who loved you. Whoever you are thinking of when reading this, go and make them proud.
